verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS, so a natural-language or AI-assistant interface is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents an OAuth-authenticated API (auth, companyCaptable, companyTransactions operations) and click-driven UI features; nothing shows the product accepting natural-language commands. The probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, which is further sign of no AI-facing surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
